description: Space selector showing the current space with a dropdown of spaces and an overview toggle that renders per-space cards with page counts and a move-current-page-here action, using the space provider.

parameters.name: SpaceProvider
parameters.description: Optional provider that supplies spaces and cross-space page moves.

parameters.name: CurrentPageId
parameters.description: Currently opened page id used by overview move actions.

parameters.name: OnCurrentPageMoved
parameters.description: Raised after the provider moves the current page to a different space.

parameters.name: SelectedSpaceId
parameters.description: Currently selected space id. Null means the provider default or implicit space.

parameters.name: SelectedSpaceIdChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the selected space id changes.
